entries.title: Claude crewmates follow this version's instructions after an update
entries.body: A Claude crewmate that was still working when you updated used to carry on with the earlier version's instructions. It now carries on in a new conversation on this version's own, picking up from its task's brief and record. Its task's timeline notes the move.
entries.noPicture: The only trace on screen is one line on the task's timeline; the change is in what a reopened crewmate is told.
